title: Major modernization — Dark mode, Clients, Recurring, Notifications, Analytics, Goals & PDF/Excel export
summary: A large modernization pass covering architecture refactoring, dark mode, client management, recurring services, in-app notifications, period-over-period analytics comparisons, revenue goal tracking, client retention insights, and PDF/Excel export from all data pages.
changes: Export: PDF and Excel export buttons on Service History, Product Sales, Analytics (commission report), Products, and Clients pages.
Export: Excel files generated via SheetJS with auto-sized columns; PDF files via jsPDF with styled tables, page numbers, and date stamps.
